answer: Main objections: hybrid/EV packaging can reduce usable boot volume so the demand that two medium suitcases + a cabin bag fit in "all production variants" may be impossible for some powertrains; owners repeatedly report tailgate unreliability, manual lids and missing internal shut buttons, so the 99%/ <1% targets could force costly changes or be unattainable without design trade‑offs. Only limited counterpoint: a small number of owners still report good trunk space, so the issue isn’t universal. Little speaks against mandating a clearly accessible internal shut control and luggage tie‑downs.
suggested_change: Allow documented exceptions for hybrid/EV variants: change the suitcase-fit requirement from "all production variants" to "all non-hybrid/EV variants; where packaging prevents the fit, require clear customer communication and compensating features (mandatory internal shut button, luggage tie‑downs and folding-seat release) and measure boot-lid durability per variant with mitigation plans if targets cannot be met.
